Create a new audience segment within the given catalog

**Sample request body**
```json
{
  "workspaceId": 43672,
  "name": "Adults in Chicago",
  "properties": {
    "name": "Adults in Chicago",
    "ageRangeMin": 45,
    "ageRangeMax": 65,
    "gender": "Neutral",
    "preferences": [
      "loves technology", "big on startups"
    ],
    "spendingBehavior": [
      "Luxury",
      "Experimental"
    ]
  }
}
```
